text:
After a lively spell, we welcome your kind words, and we are sorry to hear that your recent trip left you worried and dissatisfied about the care and handling of your companion animal and the crate used during transport. We understand how upsetting it is when a journey does not feel safe or smooth, especially when a pet is involved, and we want to address your concern with care and respect.

Your complaint appears to center on delays in support, unclear communication about the crate, and the distress this caused for both you and your pet. We take such concerns seriously. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works to match each animal with a care plan that reflects species, temperament, and comfort needs, and we expect that same attention to carry through every step of the journey. When that does not happen, we want to hear about it and make the matter right where we can.

<<FACT F118>>

We are also reviewing the handling notes linked to your trip so we can understand where the process fell short. If a crate was delayed, misplaced, or returned in poor condition, that should have been explained clearly and followed up with proper guidance. If communication from our team felt limited or inconsistent, that is not the standard we aim to maintain at Aurelia Skyways. We want travelers to feel informed, supported, and reassured from check-in through arrival.

Please know that we value the trust placed in us when a family travels with a pet. Our welcome team and desk staff are expected to provide calm assistance, practical updates, and steady oversight, and we regret that your experience did not reflect that promise. Your feedback helps us improve how we prepare, monitor, and respond in future cases.

We appreciate the chance to review this matter and to restore your confidence in our service. Your concerns will be handled with care and appropriate follow-up.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
